decisions.reason: As a strategic offshore service close to the firm's core, it likely meets aspirations given expansion and slack, so management keeps it.
Crew and corporate travel management supports core staffing operations and shows no shortfall, so slack justifies keeping it.
The online portal is still uncertain but builds on established offers, and organisational slack allows carrying it while usage is evaluated.
The mobile performance app is complementary and its results are not yet clearly below aspiration, so the firm keeps it with available slack.
